title: Tiny Machine-Learning Operations within Cyber-Physical Systems: a Field Study
abstract: arXiv:2606.20952v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine-Learning Operations (MLOps) is maturing into a software-engineering discipline, yet its tiny-scale variant (TinyMLOps)-targeting the resource-constrained microcontrollers embedded in cyber-physical systems (CPS)-remains poorly understood in industrial practice. Opaque models, noisy heterogeneous data, and tight memory budgets hinder adoption in safety-critical settings, where most decisions still rely on human experts. We report a field study of an end-to-end, knowledge-centered TinyMLOps pipeline that fuses domain physics, expert speculation, and sensor streams to deliver explainable, low-footprint models deployable on-device. The pipeline spans automated collection and cleaning of heterogeneous time series, knowledge-driven feature construction, interpretable regularized models, and rolling temporal cross-validation under concept drift. translated_title: 网络物理系统中的微型机器学习运维：一项实地研究
translated_abstract: 机器学习运维正在成熟为一门软件工程学科，然而其面向网络物理系统（CPS）中资源受限微控制器的微型版本在工业实践中仍鲜为人知。模型的不透明性、嘈杂的异构数据以及紧张的内存预算阻碍了其在安全关键场景中的落地，在这些场景中，大多数决策仍然依赖人类专家。我们报告了一项针对端到端、以知识为中心的微型机器学习运维管线的实地研究，该管线融合领域物理知识、专家推测和传感器数据流，提供可解释、低内存占用且可部署在设备端的模型。该管线涵盖异构时间序列的自动化采集与清洗、知识驱动的特征构建、可解释的正则化模型，以及概念漂移下的滚动时间交叉验证。我们在来自两次海上风电电缆开沟作业的4.4 GB数据上对其进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出并实地验证了一个以知识为中心的端到端微型机器学习运维（TinyMLOps）管线，融合领域物理知识、专家推测与传感器数据流，为资源受限的网络物理系统提供可解释、低内存占用且可部署在设备端的模型。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a field study of an end-to-end, knowledge-centered TinyMLOps pipeline that fuses domain physics, expert speculation, and sensor streams to deliver explainable, low-footprint, on-device-deployable models for resource-constrained cyber-physical systems.
